# Luxe Daily

> > Luxe Daily delivers strategic intelligence on the French and international luxury industry, covering fashion, beauty, hospitality, and automotive sectors with a focus on business transformation and sustainability.

Luxe Daily chronicles major developments in luxury brands including LVMH, Prada Group, Chanel, Hermès, and emerging players, analyzing digital transformation, sustainability initiatives, and strategic repositioning across haute couture, aviation, cruises, and lifestyle segments. The publication provides insider perspectives on how heritage brands navigate modern challenges while maintaining exclusivity.

## Key Topics

- LVMH
- Prada Group
- Versace
- Chanel
- Hermès Birkin & Kelly
- Longchamp
- Elie Saab
- Sustainable luxury (durabilité)
- Digital transformation (e-commerce)
- Haute couture
- Luxury aviation
- Explora Journeys
- B Corp certification
- French luxury (luxe-français)
- 2026 trends
